description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named ContentRowAdapter used in an Android app. It manages rendering of a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontally scrolling list of content cards. The adapter includes logic to ensure when a child view gains focus, the parent row title remains visible by requesting scrolling within the parent RecyclerView.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: A ListAdapter that displays a list of ContentRow objects, each representing a row with a title and horizontal list of content cards.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowDiff
classes.description: DiffUtil.ItemCallback implementation to optimize list updates based on ContentRow's title and content equality.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the content row, managing binding of title and inner recycler view, and handling focus changes to keep the title visible.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the list of ContentRows displayed by the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for a row by inflating the item_content_row layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow to the ViewHolder at a given position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data from a ContentRow to the ViewHolder's views, sets up the inner RecyclerView with items and focus behavior.
